answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable jade-token bond tied to one verified identity before it can trade. The bond is slashed if peers prove duplicate accounts, so creating a fake swarm means locking real value per identity. Like a gale sweeping an open tundra, one fake identity is exposed quickly when many independent verifiers check the same stake, and an attacker must fund every copy separately, making mass Sybil creation expensive rather than free.
